experiences.name: Tsukiji Outer Market Food Tour
experiences.description: Explore the bustling Tsukiji Outer Market, sampling fresh sushi, tamagoyaki, and street snacks from legendary vendors. Interact with local fishmongers and food artisans who have operated their stalls for generations, offering an authentic taste of Tokyo's culinary soul.

experiences.name: Akihabara Tech and Anime District Walk
experiences.description: Dive deep into Tokyo's iconic electric town, visiting multi-story electronics shops, retro gaming arcades, robot cafes, and cutting-edge gadget stores. Experience the epicenter of Japan's otaku and tech culture, from the latest consumer electronics to rare vintage hardware.

experiences.name: Senso-ji Temple and Asakusa Cultural Experience
experiences.description: Visit Tokyo's oldest and most iconic Buddhist temple, Senso-ji, strolling through the Nakamise shopping street lined with traditional crafts and snacks. Witness morning prayers, explore the five-story pagoda, and immerse yourself in centuries of Edo-period culture and architecture.

experiences.name: TeamLab Borderless Digital Art Museum
experiences.description: Experience one of the world's most innovative digital art installations where technology and culture merge into breathtaking immersive environments. Walk through rooms of flowing light, interactive projections, and AI-driven art that responds to your movement, representing the pinnacle of Japan's creative tech scene.

experiences.name: Shinjuku Izakaya Alley Dinner Experience
experiences.description: Venture into the narrow lantern-lit alleys of Omoide Yokocho (Memory Lane) and Kabukicho's Golden Gai, squeezing into tiny izakayas serving yakitori, ramen, and sake alongside locals. This quintessential Tokyo night-out experience blends authentic street food culture with the city's vibrant social atmosphere.
